title: Evaluating the Performance of Large Language Models for SDG Mapping (Technical Report)

live_model.evidence: "[GPT-4o] matches GPT-4 Turbo performance on text in English and code" - descriptive aside about GPT-4o's release notes; actual experiment runs GPT-4o, not GPT-4-Turbo.

prompt.location: Sec 2 ("The designed prompt for analysis was: PROMPT = ...")
prompt.note: Full prompt is for the actually-run models (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Mixtral, LLaMA 2/3, Gemma 2, Qwen2), not GPT-4-turbo.

claim.metric: none for gpt-4-turbo (not run; used only as a comparison point in GPT-4o's own release description)

data.source: 1,000 Swinburne University publications (titles/abstracts); outputs released at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.12789375

notes: GPT-4o-2024-05-13 (resolvable via the pre-2024-10-02 date rule; paper dated 2024-08-05) is actually run on 1,000 publications for SDG multi-label mapping at a stated cost of $14.58, but serves as the paper's own baseline/pseudo-ground-truth (no external labels), so no accuracy number exists for GPT-4o against ground truth either — only relative F1/precision/recall of OTHER models against GPT-4o's output.
